item_short_desc: Enhance your vehicle's look with our high-quality US antenna flag, measuring 4.5" x 6" for a perfect fit. Made with durable materials, these flags feature bold, vivid colors that catch the eye and make a statement. Easy to install, they add a touch of patriotism to any car, truck, or SUV.
